title: Add opt-in MCP call timeline and read-phase diagnostics
outcome: Ship bounded opt-in timing evidence that separates decoded receive, handler work and response dispatch/send, without claiming a cause for the historical MCP stall.
acceptance: ENGRAM_MCP_PHASE_TRACE=1 at MCP start emits correlated monotonic receive, handler-start, handler-settle, send-dispatch and send-finish observations plus read-snapshot, profiled-statement and backup-reminder summaries; tracing off adds no timestamps, allocation, profile callback, transport wrapper or writer beyond the existing TLS-active check at the new hooks.

Trace association uses fixed-size bounded state and immutable handler/send tickets; string IDs, duplicates, cancellation, saturation and dropped futures cannot produce a guessed complete association or disclose caller text. Tool/transport results, timeouts, SQLite durability and scheduling behavior remain unchanged.

Regression tests cover the phase hooks, tracing on/off, privacy and bounds, send-future ownership and actual rmcp duplicate/cancellation response orders; focused checks and the exact-input full gate pass, and documentation states observation, correlation and loss limits.

completion.summary: The opt-in MCP call timeline and read-phase diagnostics are landed (in the ancestry of e7426a6); verified on the Windows B gate bundle test-fdd408e3. An independent acceptance evaluation passed all 3 criteria (record 2e7e5758f62d4dba814b7f7e68ca96db).
